prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Hydrogen Nation, of the Fuel House. A female personification character with a hydrogen fuel-cell stack — layered plates, hoses, a faint blue glow, a drip of pure water as her motif — the object reimagined as a woman in cloth and ornament that carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs. She does NOT hold, carry or wield the object; it is not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Hydrogen (H) to carry in her design and the scene: airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water. Palette: pale sky blue, white, silver, a faint violet flame, clear glass.
HOUSE TRAITS of Fuel: a nearly invisible pale-blue flame, cryogenic frost on tanks and pipes, valves and pressure lines; clean fire that leaves only water. Palette: pale blue flame, frost white, tank silver, warning orange.
AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.
SILHOUETTE: athletic build; long side-swept hair; bright cyan hair.
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): round face; large round eyes; thick straight brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; ice-blue eyes.
WORLD — MECHA: year 2200, a fusion harbour city: a ring-shaped tokamak glowing white-blue, cryogenic hydrogen tanks, a space elevator cable rising into a pale sky, clean hard light. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. light white-and-silver armor with translucent pale-blue panels, thin frame joints, a single electron-shell ring as a halo, cryogenic frost along the seams, pale-blue flame glow lines, a slim back unit shaped like a fuel tank; the plates must read as solid armor, not cloth. Her object leads the mecha design — its silhouette and parts must read at first glance in the plates, binders, helmet and back unit.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (H) and atomic number (1) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
